answer: The network can send wandering auditors - randomly chosen established agents - to trace each identity trade graph every epoch, scoring it by how far its counterparties spiral outward into the real economy. A sybil cluster trades only with itself, so its graph ends in a closed loop and its score collapses before reaching the zenith of trust: no outside edges, no standing. Fakes must each buy genuine outside trades at real cost, while one honest agent earns its score simply by serving real customers.
